confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Rome prices. The RBA search returned an AUD/USD figure of 0.6720 for 18 November 2026, shown on the RBA homepage and Exchange Rates Overview. Restaurant and drink anchors rest on Numbeo-style aggregates as reported in search summaries (inexpensive meal about €15.6, three-course meal for two about €62.5, cappuccino about €2.1, domestic draught beer about €5.2), plus a crowd-sourced cocktail average of about €11 and typical glass-of-wine guides of about €5-8. I converted euros to USD using an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which I did not look up. Wine and cocktail figures are less certain, since cocktail data came from only a few price points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak-season July in central Rome. I did not inspect any booking pages or listings, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Rome-specific aggregated price indexes. Accommodation is judged against other major Western European tourist capitals in peak summer, such as Barcelona, Paris and Madrid.
